title: Virtual Keys
subtitle: Every key that authenticates requests to the gateway.
description: Manage virtual keys for API access and authentication
create_key_description: Generate an API key for calling LLM models through the gateway
key_created_success: Key created successfully. Please store it securely now as you will not be able to view it again.
search_placeholder: Search by key alias or ID…
search_users_placeholder: Type email to search for users
search_by_email_hint: Search by email to find users
agent_key_description: This key will be used by the selected agent to make requests to LiteLLM
team_selection_required_notice: Please select a team to continue configuring your Virtual Key. If you do not see any teams, please contact your Proxy Admin to either provide you with access to models or to add you to a team.
tooltip_owned_by: Select who will own this Virtual Key
tooltip_user_id: The user who will own this key and be responsible for its usage
tooltip_org: The organization this key belongs to. Selecting an organization filters the available teams.
tooltip_team: The team this key belongs to, which determines available models and budget limits
tooltip_project: Assign this key to a project. Selecting a project will lock the team to the project's team.
prompt_caching_description: Enabled (auto-injects cache_control markers on Anthropic and Bedrock Claude requests)
delete_key_confirm_alert: This action is irreversible and will immediately revoke access for any applications using this key.
delete_key_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this Virtual Key?
reset_spend_history_hint: Current spend: ${{spend}}. Spend history is preserved in logs. This resets the current period spend counter, the same as an automatic budget reset.
block_key_desc: Requests using this key will be rejected with a 401 error until it is unblocked. The key is not deleted and can be unblocked at any time.
unblock_key_desc: Requests using this key will be accepted again.
ai_apis_hint: Can call only AI API routes (chat/completions, embeddings, etc.)
management_hint: Can call only management routes (user/team/key management)
full_access_hint: Can call all routes (AI APIs, Management, and read-only)
blocked_by_scim: Blocked by SCIM (external identity provider deactivated or deleted the owning user).
blocked_desc: Blocked. Requests using this key will be rejected with 401.
expired_desc: This key has passed its expiry date.
active_desc: This key is not blocked and has not expired.
tooltip_col_user: Displays the first available value: User Alias, User Email, or User ID.
tooltip_col_last_active: This is a new field and is not backfilled. Only new key usage will update this value.
tooltip_max_budget: Maximum amount in USD this key can spend. When reached, the key will be blocked from making further requests
tooltip_reset_budget: How often the budget should reset. For example, setting 'daily' will reset the budget every 24 hours
model_aliases_desc: Create custom aliases for models that can be used in API calls. This allows you to create shortcuts for specific models.
tooltip_key_name_user: A descriptive name to identify this key
tooltip_key_name_sa: Unique identifier for this service account
rule_input_sa_id: Please input a service account ID
tooltip_models: Select which models this key can access. Choose 'All Team Models' to grant access to all models available to the team. Leave empty to allow access to all models.
help_models_disabled: Models field is disabled for this key type
help_models_optional: optional - leave empty to allow access to all models
tooltip_key_type: Select the type of key to determine what routes and operations this key can access
tooltip_budget_windows: Set multiple independent budget windows (e.g., hourly $10 AND monthly $200). Each window tracks spend separately and resets on its own schedule.
tooltip_per_model_budgets: Cap spend on individual models, each with its own reset window. Enforced across every request this key makes; usage is reported on the key's info page.
tooltip_budget_fallbacks: When a model exceeds its per-model budget (model_max_budget), requests automatically reroute to fallback models instead of failing. Configure per-model budgets in Advanced Settings.
tooltip_tpm_limit: Maximum number of tokens this key can process per minute. Helps control usage and costs
tooltip_rpm_limit: Maximum number of API requests this key can make per minute. Helps prevent abuse and manage load
tooltip_per_tag_rate_limits: Scope rate limits to a request tag so each tag (e.g. a cell or group) gets its own RPM counter. Requests without a matching tag fall back to the key-level limit.
tooltip_throttle_budget: When this key exceeds its max budget, throttle its TPM/RPM to the globally configured percentage instead of blocking access entirely. Requires budget_exceeded_throttle_percentage in litellm_settings and a TPM/RPM limit on the key.
tooltip_prompt_caching: Automatically add prompt caching breakpoints (cache_control markers) to requests made with this key, cutting input cost on repeated prompts. Applies to Anthropic and Bedrock Claude models; requests that already set their own cache_control markers are left untouched.
tooltip_guardrails: Apply safety guardrails to this key to filter content or enforce policies
help_guardrails_select: Select existing guardrails or enter new ones
help_guardrails_upgrade: Premium feature - Upgrade to set guardrails by key
tooltip_disable_global_guardrails: When enabled, this key will bypass any guardrails configured to run on every request (global guardrails)
help_bypass_global_guardrails: Bypass global guardrails for this key
help_upgrade_disable_global_guardrails: Premium feature - Upgrade to disable global guardrails by key
tooltip_policies: Apply policies to this key to control guardrails and other settings
help_policies_select: Select existing policies or enter new ones
help_policies_upgrade: Premium feature - Upgrade to set policies by key
tooltip_prompts: Allow this key to use specific prompt templates
help_prompts_select: Select existing prompts or enter new ones
help_prompts_upgrade: Premium feature - Upgrade to set prompts by key
tooltip_access_groups: Assign access groups to this key. Access groups control which models, MCP servers, and agents this key can use
help_access_groups: Select access groups to assign to this key
tooltip_allowed_passthrough_routes: Allow this key to use specific pass through routes
help_passthrough_select: Select existing pass through routes or enter new ones
help_passthrough_upgrade: Premium feature - Upgrade to set pass through routes by key
placeholder_passthrough: Select or enter pass through routes
tooltip_allowed_vector_stores: Select which vector stores this key can access. If none selected, the key will have access to all available vector stores
help_vector_stores: Select vector stores this key can access. Leave empty for access to all vector stores
tooltip_metadata: JSON object with additional information about this key. Used for tracking or custom logic
tooltip_tags: Tags for tracking spend and/or doing tag-based routing. Used for analytics and filtering
help_tags: Tags for tracking spend and/or doing tag-based routing.
tooltip_allowed_mcp_servers: Select which MCP servers or access groups this key can access
help_mcp_servers: Select MCP servers or access groups this key can access
placeholder_mcp_servers: Select MCP servers or access groups (optional)
tooltip_allowed_agents: Select which agents or access groups this key can access
help_agents: Select agents or access groups this key can access
tooltip_allowed_skills: Enabled skills are visible to every key. Grant disabled (private) Claude Code plugins to this key here
help_skills: Select private skills this key can access in the Claude Code marketplace
key_being_created: Key being created, this might take 30s

auto_rotation.not_enabled: Auto-rotation is not enabled for this key
auto_rotation.card_desc: Automatic key rotation settings and status for this key
